# niuu CLI reference

Every `niuu` command and option. `niuu` drives the platform itself:
authentication, contexts, the local stack, sessions, runs, and sagas.

For the agent runtime CLI see [ravn](cli-ravn.md).

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_cli_docs.py — do not edit by hand. -->

## `niuu`

The Niuu platform CLI.

```bash
niuu [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--version`, `-V` | flag |  | Print version and exit. |
| `--home` | TEXT |  | Config directory (default: ~/.niuu, env NIUU_HOME). Env: `NIUU_HOME` |
| `--config` | TEXT |  | Config file path (default: ~/.niuu/config.yaml). |
| `--install-completion` | flag |  | Install completion for the current shell. |
| `--show-completion` | flag |  | Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or customize the installation. |

| Subcommand | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`config`](#niuu-config) | Show or update configuration. |
| [`context`](#niuu-context) | Manage server contexts. |
| [`login`](#niuu-login) | Authenticate with the Niuu platform. |
| [`logout`](#niuu-logout) | Clear stored credentials. |
| [`platform`](#niuu-platform) | Manage the platform (up, down, status, init). |
| [`ravn`](#niuu-ravn) | Manage Ravn AI agent sessions. |
| [`runs`](#niuu-runs) | Manage runs. |
| [`sagas`](#niuu-sagas) | Manage sagas. |
| [`sessions`](#niuu-sessions) | Manage coding sessions. |
| [`tui`](#niuu-tui) | Launch the interactive TUI. |
| [`version`](#niuu-version) | Print the niuu CLI version. |
| [`whoami`](#niuu-whoami) | Show the currently authenticated user. |

### `niuu config`

Show or update configuration.

```bash
niuu config [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

| Subcommand | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`set`](#niuu-config-set) | Set a configuration value. |
| [`show`](#niuu-config-show) | Show current CLI configuration. |

#### `niuu config set`

Set a configuration value.

```bash
niuu config set [OPTIONS] KEY VALUE
```

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `KEY` | yes | Config key (e.g. server.port) |
| `VALUE` | yes | New value |

#### `niuu config show`

Show current CLI configuration.

```bash
niuu config show [OPTIONS]
```

### `niuu context`

Manage server contexts.

```bash
niuu context [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

| Subcommand | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`add`](#niuu-context-add) | Add a new server context. |
| [`delete`](#niuu-context-delete) | Remove a context. |
| [`list`](#niuu-context-list) | List all configured contexts. |
| [`use`](#niuu-context-use) | Switch to a context. |

#### `niuu context add`

Add a new server context.

```bash
niuu context add [OPTIONS] NAME URL
```

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NAME` | yes | Context name |
| `URL` | yes | Server URL |

#### `niuu context delete`

Remove a context.

```bash
niuu context delete [OPTIONS] NAME
```

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NAME` | yes | Context name to remove |

#### `niuu context list`

List all configured contexts.

```bash
niuu context list [OPTIONS]
```

#### `niuu context use`

Switch to a context.

```bash
niuu context use [OPTIONS] NAME
```

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NAME` | yes | Context name to activate |

### `niuu login`

Authenticate with the Niuu platform.

```bash
niuu login [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--issuer`, `-i` | TEXT |  | OIDC issuer URL. Env: `NIUU_OIDC_ISSUER` |
| `--client-id` | TEXT | `niuu-cli` | OIDC client ID. Env: `NIUU_OIDC_CLIENT_ID` |

### `niuu logout`

Clear stored credentials.

```bash
niuu logout [OPTIONS]
```

### `niuu platform`

Manage the platform (up, down, status, init).

```bash
niuu platform [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

| Subcommand | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`down`](#niuu-platform-down) | Stop all running services. |
| [`init`](#niuu-platform-init) | Run the first-time setup wizard. |
| [`inventory`](#niuu-platform-inventory) | Show or export the route domains mounted by the niuu host. |
| [`skuld`](#niuu-platform-skuld) | Run a Skuld broker instance (internal, one per session). |
| [`status`](#niuu-platform-status) | Show health of all registered services. |
| [`up`](#niuu-platform-up) | Start platform services (use --all to start everything). |

#### `niuu platform down`

Stop all running services.

```bash
niuu platform down [OPTIONS]
```

#### `niuu platform init`

Run the first-time setup wizard.

```bash
niuu platform init [OPTIONS]
```

#### `niuu platform inventory`

Show or export the route domains mounted by the niuu host.

```bash
niuu platform inventory [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--host-profile` | TEXT | `full` | Host profile used to resolve mounted route domains. |
| `--mounts` | TEXT |  | Comma-separated route domains to inventory instead of the profile default. |
| `--json` | flag |  | Print route inventory as JSON. |
| `--out` | TEXT |  | Optional file path to write the JSON route inventory report. |

#### `niuu platform skuld`

Run a Skuld broker instance (internal, one per session).

```bash
niuu platform skuld [OPTIONS]
```

#### `niuu platform status`

Show health of all registered services.

```bash
niuu platform status [OPTIONS]
```

#### `niuu platform up`

Start platform services (use --all to start everything).

```bash
niuu platform up [OPTIONS]
```

| `--audit`, `--no-audit` | flag |  |  |
| `--bifrost`, `--no-bifrost` | flag |  |  |

| `--features`, `--no-features` | flag |  |  |
| `--guild`, `--no-guild` | flag |  |  |
| `--identity`, `--no-identity` | flag |  |  |
| `--integrations`, `--no-integrations` | flag |  |  |
| `--mimir`, `--no-mimir` | flag |  |  |
| `--niuu`, `--no-niuu` | flag |  |  |
| `--observatory`, `--no-observatory` | flag |  |  |
